column1: # Manual table entries, merged into rewrite-table.tsv by derive.py.
# columns: kind, owner, name, desc, targetOwner, targetName, targetDesc, recipe
# RENAME is derived automatically; only ALIAS (owner/name change) and CONVERT (argument change) belong here.
# Every target is validated against the real L3 jars.
# vertex array pointers: L2 infers the type from the buffer class, L3 requires it explicitly
# L3 3.4.x dropped the count+type+Buffer form, so pass the raw address
# ARB shader uniforms -> core GL20 (identical descriptor, pure owner/name redirect)
# new PointerBuffer(ByteBuffer) -> allocation of the subclass that keeps the container, as LWJGL2 did
# both-exist classes: LWJGL3 dropped the member, the adapter rebuilds it from the modern API
# the typed suffix family is ambiguous here (iv vs uiv), so pin the signed form
